sources.title: Founder context
sources.locator: Conversation, October 5 2026: all paths; no onboardings yet; founder will conduct first cohort

users.description: Founder personally assists and observes initial onboardings.
Customer administrator verifies data, access and operating readiness.
Invited resident reaches a useful task with correct community and unit access.

tasks.description: Prepare existing data, preview truthfully, reconcile and recover failures before resident rollout.
Observe invitation through correct access and first useful task before broad rollout.
Measure founder effort and customer effort separately; automate recurring friction.

claims.text: No onboarding baseline exists; founder plans to run the first cohort personally.
Resident dry run returns before live membership and unit eligibility checks; preview rebuilds filtered source row numbers.
Batch invitations and multi-document uploads already exist.
Operator active stage derives from subscription state and creation time, not reconciled migration readiness.
The first-run wizard spec contains obsolete fixme cases.

assumptions.description: A worksheet and existing tools can support the initial cohort after identified reliability defects and customer-specific blockers are resolved.

validation.hypothesis: Founder-assisted rehearsals complete the agreed first useful workflow with reconciled records and recoverable exceptions.
killCriteria: A target customer requires unsupported relationships or historical financial migration on day one.
Measured batch performance or failure recovery prevents a reliable pilot with existing tools.

unknowns.description: Actual customer exports, relationship complexity and day-one history requirements are unknown.
unknowns.rationale: Does not block a bounded audit; resolve at intake before committing to a specific customer migration.

unknowns.description: Safe deployment-equivalent import and invite batch sizes are unmeasured.
unknowns.rationale: Does not block findings; prevents an unlimited-scale claim and requires rehearsal before large imports.

unknowns.description: Authenticated journey verification was unavailable: Docker stopped and dependencies absent.
unknowns.rationale: Audit is source-based; launch readiness remains unverified until an isolated sandbox rehearsal succeeds.

directionCriteria.description: Preview results correspond to source rows and all eligibility conditions known before commit.
directionCriteria.measurement: Mixed-row rehearsal preserves source numbering and detects invalid units/membership before mutation; races are rechecked.

directionCriteria.description: Launch is based on verified records and successful user tasks rather than setup or billing status.
directionCriteria.measurement: Customer validates agreed counts/relationships and representative pilot users complete the chosen real task.

directionCriteria.description: Reuse existing import, document, invitation and operator tools before introducing additional systems.
directionCriteria.measurement: Every proposed addition names an observed limit or repeated customer problem and explains why an existing tool is insufficient.

auditOnlyException: Source-bounded audit and founder operating plan only. No customer research, production performance, release certification, visual direction, or application implementation is claimed.
